items.question: What orientation and posture should one adopt after sipping water and sitting on the prescribed seat?
items.inference: Ritual preparation requires sipping, seating, and east-or-north orientation.
uncertainties: Fused sandhi obscures exact word boundaries.
items.plain_english: Having sipped water, seated on the prescribed seat, one faces east or north.
